scope: Super Power Drill only: independently maintained catalog dimensions, physical inserts and explicit pairings from printed p128-135.

dimension_definitions.D: Diameter shown in the holder table, with catalog ±0.2 mm label. Do not silently replace with a user-required tolerance.
dimension_definitions.T: Drilling-depth dimension T in the p130 drawing. Use this field for standard reach screening, not L or L1.
dimension_definitions.L: Length L exactly as drawn in p130; not the rear-shank-inclusive assembled total.
dimension_definitions.L1: Length L1 exactly as drawn in p130, ending at the front of the rear shank.
dimension_definitions.d1: Collar diameter Ød1, separate from the common rear-shank diameter Ø32.
dimension_definitions.rear_shank: p130 drawing shows Ø32 and an axial 58 mm. It does not provide a machine-side holder SKU or a minimum-clamping length.

pairing_rules.recommendation_source: p135 cutting table specifies center/periphery grade pairs by material, depth band and diameter group; use those pairs rather than a global material-to-grade mapping.

direct_substitution_for_standard_holder_.note: p132 NC40 parts have matching L/S/re with their NC2032 counterparts and share screw cells; holder tables p130–131 list only unsuffixed parts. p135 NC40+NC40 rows exist for the larger sizes. Obtain manufacturer confirmation of an explicit replacement map before treating suffixed parts as aliases.

open_questions.issue: N9GX060204 periphery screw differs by source/diameter group: NS-22055 for holder Ø30–34 on p131 vs NS-22062 on p132 and holder Ø22–29 on p130. Confirm exact assembly screw per holder.
Printed Ø27 inch conversion is 1.630 inch. Metric 27 mm converts arithmetically to about 1.063 inch; keep original metric selector and request correction.
00-99307-39300 lists L=346 mm. Preserve printed value and confirm whether an erratum is required.
Confirm complete order codes for CD6/CD8 grades; no concatenated grade suffix is printed.
Confirm explicit NC40 periphery substitution map (N9GX06020431/N9GX09030831) for standard holder listed unsuffixed parts and applicable screws.
Confirm machine-side clamping selection/allowed overhang. Diagram rear shank Ø32 x 58 is not a stated minimum clamping requirement.
